def f(g, K=4):
    s=g; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]

    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if s[i][j]!=bg: continue
            fill=False
            # horizontal
            dl=next((d for d in range(1,w) if j-d>=0 and s[i][j-d]==sc), None)
            dr=next((d for d in range(1,w) if j+d<w and s[i][j+d]==sc), None)
            if dl and dr and dl+dr-1<=K: fill=True
            du=next((d for d in range(1,h) if i-d>=0 and s[i-d][j]==sc), None)
            dd=next((d for d in range(1,h) if i+d<h and s[i+d][j]==sc), None)
            if du and dd and du+dd-1<=K: fill=True
            if fill: out[i][j]=2

from collections import Counter
def transform(grid):
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for r in grid for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    sc = [(i, j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if grid[i][j] != bg]
    shape_c = grid[sc[0][0]][sc[0][1]]
    rs = {i for i, _ in sc}; cs = {j for _, j in sc}
    rowcnt = Counter(i for i, _ in sc); colcnt = Counter(j for _, j in sc)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if grid[i][j] != bg: continue
            if not (min(rs) <= i <= max(rs) and min(cs) <= j <= max(cs)): continue

            if (rowhas and rowcnt[i] >= 4) or (colhas and colcnt[j] >= 4):
                out[i][j] = 2
    return out
